classDefinitions.A: acquired and used in this repository
classDefinitions.B: usable after preprocessing - open licence, relevant variables, usable scale
classDefinitions.C: external validation only - wrong task, sensor or size for training
classDefinitions.D: scientific reference only - open and correct, but cannot validate this product
classDefinitions.E: needs an agreement or a licence decision before use
classDefinitions.F: not suitable - the licence prohibits the intended use

datasets.name: NASA POWER daily agroclimatology (community AG)
datasets.publisher: NASA Langley Research Center, POWER Project
datasets.format: JSON / CSV / NetCDF via REST point and regional APIs
datasets.units: MJ m^-2 d^-1; degC; %; m s^-1; kPa; mm day^-1
datasets.license: NASA open data: no restrictions on use, access or download; citation requested
datasets.classReason: Acquired and used: the ET0 target and the emulator features are derived from it. The licence permits redistribution and commercial use.
datasets.importNote: data/raw/nasa_power/*.json via ml/research/acquire_power_climate.py
datasets.caveat: Reanalysis on a coarse grid: a site label is a grid-cell value, not an instrument reading, and its MERRA-2 lineage means it cannot validate itself.

datasets.name: SMAP L4 Global 3-hourly 9 km surface and root-zone soil moisture (SPL4SMGP v8)
datasets.license: NASA open data policy; free Earthdata login required
datasets.classReason: Open, correct variables, but 9 km is open-field soil moisture - it would support an open-field deployment, not the controlled-environment system the product models. Not imported.
datasets.importNote: no substrate or root-zone state model exists to consume it
datasets.caveat: A different system at a different scale from a hydroponic root zone.

datasets.name: MODIS/Terra Vegetation Indices 16-Day L3 Global 250 m (MOD13Q1 v061)
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 (AWS Open Data registry entry for MODIS)
datasets.classReason: Open and preprocessed, but 250 m / 16-day is far coarser than a single growth module. Usable for a field-scale context layer, not for the per-module model.
datasets.importNote: no field-scale context layer in the product yet
datasets.caveat: A 16-day composite cannot resolve a growth stage that turns over in days.

datasets.name: GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 Half Hourly 0.1 deg (3B-HH v07)
datasets.license: openly shared without restriction per EOSDIS policy; Earthdata login required
datasets.classReason: High-quality open precipitation at 0.1 deg. It does not enter ET0 - FAO-56 needs no precipitation term for a daily reference - and no irrigation or drainage model consumes it yet.
datasets.importNote: candidate input for a future water-balance closure
datasets.caveat: Citation requested: Huffman, Stocker, Bolvin, Nelkin & Tan (2023), DOI 10.5067/GPM/IMERG/3B-HH/07.

datasets.name: ERA5-Land hourly reanalysis
datasets.publisher: Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) via the Climate Data Store
datasets.units: K; m; J m^-2; m s^-1; Pa; m
datasets.license: Copernicus licence: free, attribution and no endorsement required
datasets.classReason: External validation input, not training data. Used through a credential-free delivery for its 0.1 deg temperature field only: that route returns null for radiation and wind, so it cannot drive a full FAO-56 computation. The hourly radiation and wind fields still require a CDS token and were not retrieved.
datasets.importNote: data/validation/et0/ - temperature-only Hargreaves leg, no training use
datasets.caveat: Temperature-only in every result reported here, and its 0.1 deg Tmax was further from the station than ERA5 0.25 deg at all six validation sites: a finer grid is not automatically closer to a point observation.

datasets.name: ERA5 hourly reanalysis (0.25 deg) via Open-Meteo archive
datasets.publisher: ECMWF/C3S, delivered by the Open-Meteo archive API
datasets.units: degC; degC; W m^-2; m s^-1; hPa; mm d^-1
datasets.license: Open-Meteo CC BY 4.0; values under the Copernicus licence
datasets.classReason: The primary forcing of the independent ET0 validation and the source of the provider's own FAO-56 series used as the implementation control. External validation only; it never enters training.
datasets.importNote: data/validation/et0/harmonised_daily.csv - validation forcing
datasets.caveat: A reanalysis: agreement with it bounds implementation and forcing error, not physical truth, and it shares much of its observing system with MERRA-2.

datasets.name: NOAA ISD-Lite hourly surface observations
datasets.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
datasets.format: gzipped fixed-width text, one file per station-year
datasets.units: degC (stored as tenths); hPa; m s^-1; coded
datasets.license: U.S. Government work, public domain
datasets.classReason: The only leg in the ET0 validation with no reanalysis lineage: a point station measurement. It carries no radiation field, so it can only support a temperature-based method. External validation only.
datasets.importNote: data/validation/et0/ - Hargreaves observational leg
datasets.caveat: A point observation at an airport, not a grid cell: representativeness, not accuracy, is the limiting factor, and it cannot confirm the radiation term.

datasets.name: SoilGrids 2.0 predicted soil properties
datasets.format: GeoTIFF / VRT via WebDAV and REST
datasets.coverage: global, 250 m, 7 standard depths to 200 cm
datasets.units: g kg^-1; kg dm^-3; dS m^-1; pH
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0
datasets.classReason: Open and useful, but it describes soil, and the platform models a hydroponic or substrate system. Relevant only if an open-field mode is added.
datasets.importNote: no soil model in the product
datasets.caveat: Predictions, with their own uncertainty; not measurements at any site.

datasets.name: CHIRPS v2.0 quasi-global precipitation
datasets.license: public domain per the CHC data page; citation requested
datasets.classReason: Open, finer than IMERG for accumulation, but precipitation is not an input to daily reference ET0 and no water-balance model consumes it.
datasets.importNote: candidate precipitation input alongside IMERG; one of the two is enough
datasets.caveat: Station-blended, so its independence from POWER depends on the station network.

datasets.name: Global Wheat Head Detection 2021
datasets.format: JPEG images with Pascal-VOC-style bounding boxes
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0
datasets.classReason: Excellent labelled data for a task the product does not perform: wheat head detection in field imagery. No imaging pipeline exists, so this is external validation material only, never a training set for a capability we do not ship.
datasets.importNote: no imaging capability to validate
datasets.caveat: A model trained here would detect wheat, not the crops this platform simulates.

datasets.name: NASA OSDR / GeneLab plant experiment corpus
datasets.coverage: per study; small, heterogeneous, mostly Arabidopsis
variables: some harvest mass and phenotype tables
datasets.license: NASA open data policy: no restrictions on use; per-study citation
datasets.classReason: Used for provenance and as a qualitative prior only. The studies are too few, too heterogeneous and mostly the wrong species to train or validate a yield model.
datasets.importNote: data/metadata/dataset_manifest.json - provenance only, never a feature
datasets.caveat: Microgravity studies exist here, but none with the replication a response function needs.

datasets.name: Published lettuce light-intensity and temperature trial (PeerJ 17085)
datasets.format: HTML/Markdown tables in an open-access article
datasets.coverage: 6 observations, one cultivar, light intensity x temperature
datasets.units: g per plant; umol m^-2 s^-1; degC
datasets.license: article CC BY 4.0; the extracted table is a derived dataset
datasets.classReason: Six observations. Enough to sit beside a prediction as an external check, nowhere near enough to fit or tune anything, and it is never used as training data.
datasets.importNote: data/literature/external_lettuce_peerj17085.json - validation only
datasets.caveat: One cultivar, one facility: agreement here is a sanity check, not validation.

datasets.name: DeepWeeds: weed image classification in northern Australia
datasets.publisher: Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (CSIRO) via Zenodo
datasets.coverage: 17,509 images, 8 weed species plus negative class, field imagery
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 per the Zenodo record
datasets.classReason: Open field-weed imagery for a classification task the product does not perform. Recorded because it is the standard counter-example to using PlantVillage for anything field-realistic.
datasets.importNote: no weed or imagery capability exists
datasets.caveat: Not checked against the platform's crop set; validation value only.

datasets.name: FLUXNET2015 eddy-covariance flux tower dataset
datasets.publisher: FLUXNET community, distributed via the FLUXNET data portal
datasets.format: CSV per site, half-hourly and aggregated
datasets.units: W m^-2; degC; hPa; m s^-1; %
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 per site, subject to accepting the FLUXNET data policy
datasets.commercialUse: permitted with attribution, after accepting the data policy
datasets.classReason: The strongest validation material this project has identified: measured latent heat flux at grassland towers is an independent check on a reference-ET calculation, which is exactly what the `independent-et0` gap asks for. It cannot train the emulator - the towers are not the six reference sites and the footprint is a field, not a module - so it is validation only, and it is not imported yet.
datasets.importNote: requires accepting the data policy; tower footprints differ from the sites
datasets.caveat: Eddy-covariance energy-balance closure is typically 10-20 % off, so a mismatch of that size would not settle the question either way.

datasets.name: PlantVillage leaf-disease image dataset
datasets.coverage: 54,306 images, 38 classes, lab-collected leaves on uniform backgrounds
datasets.license: conflicting records: CC BY-SA 3.0 (HF card) vs GPL-2 (Kaggle mirror) vs none (GitHub)
datasets.commercialUse: undecided - the ShareAlike term and the conflicting records disagree
datasets.classReason: A commercial product cannot proceed on a dataset whose own distribution points state three different licences, one of which is a copyleft that would reach the model weights. Needs a licence decision, and its lab photographs would transfer poorly to field imagery in any case.
datasets.importNote: licence decision required before any use
datasets.caveat: Widely used as if open; the licence conflict is the reason it is not used here.

datasets.name: FAO WaPOR - water productivity through open access of remotely sensed derived data
datasets.format: GeoTIFF via FAO portal and API
datasets.coverage: Africa and Near East, 100 m / 250 m, decadal, 2009-present
datasets.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 - non-commercial
datasets.classReason: The only open product that measures actual (not reference) evapotranspiration, and it is non-commercial. A commercial deployment would need an agreement with FAO; it cannot be used as delivered.
datasets.importNote: non-commercial licence is disqualifying under this project's rules
datasets.caveat: Would be the strongest validation of a crop water model if the licence allowed it.

datasets.name: PlanetScope daily 3 m imagery
datasets.coverage: global, 3-5 m, daily revisit, commercial subscription
datasets.license: commercial subscription; no redistribution of derived products without agreement
datasets.classReason: The only daily 3 m imagery that would make per-module imaging feasible, and it is a paid subscription. Out of scope by the project's no-paid-services rule.
datasets.importNote: paid service; forbidden by the project constraints
datasets.caveat: Recorded so the imaging gap has a named, priced answer rather than a vague one.

datasets.name: OpenET ensemble evapotranspiration
datasets.coverage: continental United States, 30 m and field-scale, 2016-present
datasets.license: free for research with registration; commercial terms require an agreement
datasets.classReason: Actual ET is exactly the missing measurement class, but the coverage is US-only and the commercial terms are not open. Needs a licence decision and would still not cover the six reference sites outside the US.
datasets.importNote: licence decision plus a coverage limit
datasets.caveat: An ensemble of models, so its disagreement is itself the uncertainty estimate.

datasets.name: PlantCLEF 2021 plant identification challenge data
datasets.format: JPEG images with species labels, registration required
datasets.coverage: millions of plant images, species-level labels, herbarium and field
datasets.license: research-use terms; redistribution restricted; per-image provenance varies
datasets.classReason: Species identification is not a capability the product claims, and the agreement forbids redistribution. Kept in the catalogue only so a future contributor does not mistake it for an open dataset.
datasets.importNote: agreement required; task not in scope
datasets.caveat: Aggregated from many sources with heterogeneous underlying licences.

datasets.name: FAOSTAT crop production and yield statistics
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0
datasets.classReason: Free and authoritative, and structurally unable to validate this product: a country-year yield aggregate cannot be compared with a per-square-metre controlled-environment model. Reference context only.
datasets.importNote: level of aggregation incompatible with the model's support
datasets.caveat: National aggregates mix field, greenhouse and subsistence production.

datasets.name: Present-day and future Koppen-Geiger climate classification (Beck et al. 2018)
datasets.publisher: University of Idaho / ETH Zurich, hosted on figshare
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0
datasets.classReason: Used only to justify why the six reference sites were chosen to span climates. A categorical map cannot validate a continuous flux.
datasets.importNote: context for site selection, not an input
datasets.caveat: Classification, not weather; two sites in one class can differ entirely.

datasets.name: NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 statistically downscaled climate projections
datasets.coverage: global, 0.25 deg, daily, 1950-2100 across CMIP6 models
datasets.units: K; mm day^-1; %; W m^-2; m s^-1
datasets.license: open (NASA NEX); model-specific citation requested
datasets.classReason: The right product for a future-climate siting claim, which the platform does not make. Validating an observed-weather ET0 study against projections would be a category error.
datasets.importNote: out of scope for an observed-weather study
datasets.caveat: Downscaled model output: uncertainty is the spread across models, not one file.

datasets.name: PlantWild in-the-wild plant image dataset
datasets.publisher: PlantWild authors, hosted on Hugging Face
datasets.license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 - non-commercial, no derivatives
datasets.classReason: Not suitable at any effort: the no-derivatives term prohibits training on it, and training a model is a derivative use. Recorded as the clearest example in this list of a licence that forbids the intended use outright.
datasets.importNote: licence prohibits the intended use
datasets.caveat: Kept in the catalogue so the exclusion is a documented decision, not an omission.
